title: Dimitri Dedue Northeast Hold
prompt:
At the northeast approach, Dedue, very tall, broad-shouldered, white-haired and shield-wall strong, blocks a padded strike with a large training shield while Dimitri, youthful blond prince, holds back behind him with restrained lance posture. Red-black Black Eagles pressure and distant faculty heal-tile silhouettes create depth beyond the low stone wall. The moment shows Blue Lions defensive discipline under Byleth teaching, not a random duel.

Cinematic continuity: Block=Mock Battle Expanded. Transition in: Byleth correction redirects attention to disciplined northeast hold. Transition out: Dimitri restraint beat follows from Dedue shield block. Screen/camera rule: Northeast pressure comes right/deep to left/near; Dedue stops it; Dimitri stays anchored behind shield line. Audio bridge: shield thud, controlled breath, training weapons. Generate with 2s editorial handle where possible; begin and end with usable motion, not a frozen poster. Maintain direction, eyelines, and spatial geography from adjacent shots.

Youth/beauty guard: Keep academy students youthful, attractive, clean-skinned and official-game-inspired. Show tactical pressure through blocking, posture, sound and editing rather than aging faces.

Camera: medium-wide shield-line angle with Dimitri behind Dedue and northeast depth beyond

Scene09 production gate: do not generate final video from the blocked source image if it is SVG or legacy training-yard raster. Use production_image_path after a real cinematic raster keyframe is generated and QA-approved.
Character continuity gate: every named character must match the listed selected.png reference assets for face, hair, age, costume silhouette, and color accents.
negative_prompt: No game UI, no subtitles, no readable text, no watermark, no modern objects. No identity drift, face swaps, costume drift, extra limbs, warped hands, flickering faces, or sudden style changes. No middle-aged face unless canonically required, no old face, no wrinkles, no tired eye bags, no harsh pores, no weathered skin, no gaunt face, no matronly look, no gritty realism, no generic medieval extra. Keep academy students youthful, attractive, clean-skinned and official-game-inspired; use controlled academy sparring only, no blood or lethal injury. Avoid: skinny Dedue, old Dimitri, straight training lane, lethal injury, blood, generic armor, wrong hair colors, text, watermark

transition_out: Dimitri restraint beat follows from Dedue shield block
screen_direction_rule: Northeast pressure comes right/deep to left/near; Dedue stops it; Dimitri stays anchored behind shield line
audio_bridge: shield thud, controlled breath, training weapons
risk_notes: Needs Dedue robust and Dimitri controlled, plus visible northeast enemy pressure and faculty line beyond.
